text:
anya: Quick FYI — I pushed a diff to the overlays repo that wires the secret mappings for prod/staging. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/overlays/pull/482
lee: Thanks. Is this the change that flips the k8s service account role to read-only for the model cache?
samir: Yep. Also adds `kustomize` patch for the `cache-credentials` secret name per the new KMS flow.
anya: Correct. Two parts: terraform side adds new secret in vault (module.k8s_secrets.cache_creds) and overlays update the `secretGenerator` reference.
marta: Can you paste the terraform target command you used? I want to run plan locally before I approve.
anya: `terraform plan -target=module.k8s_secrets -var-file=env/staging.tfvars` — that produced only the new `vault_generic_secret.cache_creds` resource.
lee: For prod we'll need to coordinate a short maintenance window because the pod rollout touches the cache init container. Not a full outage but brief warms.
samir: Also note the kustomize patch renames the key from `token` -> `cache_token` to avoid collision with legacy services. I added a compatibility migration in the init script (small grep fallback).
devex: @anya can you include a short upgrade note in the PR description so SDK teams know to look for `cache_token`?
anya: Will do. Adding migration steps + a one-liner for telemetry tag so we can correlate errors.
infra-bot: deploy-checklist: terraform-plan OK, overlay-lint OK, unit-tests OK. (auto-run results) :white_check_mark:
lee: PR looks fine to me. @marta or @samir can you approve for staging?
marta: Approving for staging. I'll run `terraform apply -target=module.k8s_secrets` at 09:00 PT and then kick the k8s rollout.
samir: I'll watch the rollout and have a rollback patch ready. If the cache init fails, the rollout will be paused and we can revert overlay ref.
anya: Thanks. For prod gating: we'll schedule prod apply after the staging smoke is green + one-hour monitoring. I'll file the release gating checklist in the PR.
lee: One more ask — can we pin the image tag in the staging overlay instead of `latest`? small follow-up PR?
anya: Yep. I'll open a tiny PR to pin to `image: redis-cache:2026-02-18` and queue it behind this merge.
infra-bot: deploy-status: staging rollout started by marta at 1772104995. Logs watcher attached.
marta: staging looks green so far, cache init time ~8s, no auth errors.
samir: rolling back plan ready in case. :mechanical_arm:
devex: awesome — thanks everyone. I'll blast a short note on #eng-notifications once prod gate is complete.
anya: Closing loop: I added the upgrade note, migration script, and a small test that verifies `cache_token` presence. PR updated. Ready for final approvals.
lee: Approved for prod floor check.
marta: Approved. Scheduling prod apply for 11:30 PT.
anya: Great — thanks!
